substantive_checks.portfolio_height: PASS: multiplying the positive continuant bounds gives L log(4n+6)<=H<=L log(4(n+L+1)), hence H=O(n) exactly when L=O(n/log n)
substantive_checks.truncated_depth: PASS: valuation additivity gives the exact truncated weighted sum of the return depths for both residual and scalar-Casoratian products
substantive_checks.bounded_multiplicity: PASS: for total multiplicity at most fixed K, full depth s forces one O(n/log n) return at level p^ceil(s/K)
substantive_checks.antiperiod_optimizer: PASS: the convex exchange argument gives (K-r)(p^q-1)+r(p^(q+1)-1) for s=Kq+r
substantive_checks.fixed_K_no_go: PASS WITH SCOPE: canonical anti-period portfolios of fixed K and O(n) height force only s log p=O_K(log n); accidental shorter actual returns are not excluded
substantive_checks.reservoir_deoverlap: PASS: the depth formula uses precisely s=(v_p(q_n)-v_p(D_m))_+ after the Item 265 clearing reservoir
substantive_checks.capacity_booking: PASS: no uniform short-return theorem, unbounded-portfolio theorem, sum-cancellation theorem, or beta-capacity reduction is proved; booking is zero

strict_scope.proved: Bounded-multiplicity products have an exact height-depth tradeoff and the canonical anti-period construction cannot reach dangerous singleton depths at linear height.
strict_scope.not_proved: Actual short returns, sums with cancellation, arbitrary growing block determinants, and genuinely unbounded independent portfolios remain open.
strict_scope.finite_only: The deterministic replay checks exact bounded identities and makes no exceptional-prime or distributional extrapolation.
